# PL Strength — https://pl-strength.app
#
# This is a sign-in-only app, so almost nothing here is crawlable to begin with:
# a crawler fetching any route gets an empty shell, since the content only
# renders after Firebase auth. These rules cover the static files that ARE
# served publicly alongside the app, and opt out of AI training crawlers.
#
# robots.txt is voluntary — well-behaved crawlers honor it, scrapers don't.
# Cloudflare's bot controls are what actually enforce this.

# ── General crawlers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Search engines may index the landing page (so the app stays findable), but
# not the training documents served from /docs/.
User-agent: *
Disallow: /docs/

# ── AI training / scraping crawlers ─────────────────────────────────────────
# Google-Extended opts out of Gemini training WITHOUT affecting Google Search.

User-agent: GPTBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: OAI-SearchBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: ChatGPT-User
Disallow: /

User-agent: ClaudeBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: Claude-User
Disallow: /

User-agent: anthropic-ai
Disallow: /

User-agent: Google-Extended
Disallow: /

User-agent: PerplexityBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: Perplexity-User
Disallow: /

User-agent: CCBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: Bytespider
Disallow: /

User-agent: Amazonbot
Disallow: /

User-agent: Applebot-Extended
Disallow: /

User-agent: meta-externalagent
Disallow: /

User-agent: cohere-ai
Disallow: /

User-agent: Diffbot
Disallow: /

User-agent: ImagesiftBot
Disallow: /
